fix: correct operator precedence in List.js $getLineNum (#1731)

The expression `$str.match(/\n/g)?.length ?? 0 + beginLine` is parsed as
`$str.match(/\n/g)?.length ?? (0 + beginLine)` because `+` has higher
precedence than `??`. This means `beginLine` is completely ignored when
the match succeeds, causing incorrect line count on list rendering.

Both imgSizeHandler and imgToolHandler set a fallback setTimeout in

references to the handler and its DOM nodes, preventing garbage
collection.

Store the timer ID and clear it in remove().
